### Description
Add weather information feature to display current weather conditions for destinations.

### Proposed Feature
The application should display weather information including:
- Current temperature
- Weather conditions (sunny, cloudy, rainy, etc.)
- Forecast information
- Integration with a weather API service

### Use Case
Users planning their trips would benefit from seeing current weather conditions and forecasts for their destination cities. This helps them make better travel decisions.

### Suggested Implementation
- Integrate with a weather API (e.g., OpenWeatherMap, Weather.com API)
- Display weather information on destination city cards
- Show 5-7 day forecast for selected destinations
- Cache weather data to reduce API calls

### Additional Context
Weather information is a common feature in travel booking applications and would enhance the user experience significantly.

### Expected Behavior
When users view destination cities or search for flights, they should see relevant weather information to help inform their travel decisions.
